contexts.text: (The Antediluvians) under a misty rock. AC 1512. AC 1673:2.

One who had seemed to himself to be great and wise in comparison with others... was encompassed as it were with a mist; which, advancing from him, began to cover over the Spirits, causing them distress... Such is the sphere of authority there. SE 2681.
In the Hells... there appears a thick dark mist, in which they live.
A well seen from which came forth a bright mist. Explained.
The misty and thick dark sphere which exhales from the evils and falsities of those who are in Hell, appears like a mountain or rock, beneath which they are hidden.
They looked through my eyes into the light of the world, and perceived it as a dark mist... In such is man.

Those of the old Church are then in a kind of inundation... which appears like a foggy mist... The state of those who are in this foggy mist is that they cannot possibly see what the truth of faith is, and still less what its good is; for the light of Heaven... cannot penetrate into this mist. This is the state of a vastated Church.

Progression towards interior things... in the other life... is from a kind of mist into the light; for they who are solely in exterior things are relatively in a mist; and are also seen by the Angels in a mist... and, wonderful to say, they who are in a mist cannot see those who are in light that they are in light: whereas they who are in light can see those who are in a mist that they are in a mist.
They cast themselves down from the light there into some infernal mist, where they receive their former respiration, and appear to themselves... as Spirits not evil.
For the thick dark mists which appear around them, are the mountains.
This state (of temptation), when presented to view there... appears like a mist exhaled from dirty places...
But, when the state of temptation ceases, this mist is dissipated...
The Angels distinctly apprehended all things... which appeared around that thing as a mist.

Each Hell is separated from another as by mists, clouds, or waters. Evils and falsities... appear before the eyes of Spirits as mists and clouds... the falsities from the evils of those who had been of the Celestial Church as mists.

Lest those who are in falsities and evils should be wholly destroyed and tortured, they are covered over by their own falsities and evils as with mists, which are of such a nature as to break the influx of the Divine, or to repel, or suffocate it; as earthly mists or clouds are wont to do the rays of the sun. Signified.
All in Hell are covered over with dense mists; for mists are falsities.
A higher Heaven appears as something misty above their heads.
Like the difference of what is clear relatively to the obscurity of a mist.
The Heavens... sometimes appear to Spirits as mists...
When the Hells are opened, there is an exhalation, (sometimes) like a mist and a dense cloud.
A mist and a dense cloud correspond to the derivative falsities.

There was seen above them... as it were a mistiness, which appeared from the presence of the Lord in the angelic Heavens... especially from His presence in the Ultimate Heaven, lest any of them should be taken away and perish, on account of their conjunction with them.
There is a general sphere around many in Society, (which appears) in Hell under the shape of a gross and black mist.
There then appeared as it were a mist ascending from the lower regions (which made them think) that they were kings and princes.
The Angel... passing through the mist, ascended... and then the circle... let itself down, and dispelled the mist which had induced darkness on the earth.
They were to be approached from the east, lest we should enter into the mist of their phantasy...
Lo, a house... standing in a mist, which continually flowed forth like smoke through the chinks of three of the walls.
Like the difference between those who stand in clear light... and those who stand in a dense mist...
If one from a mountain sees a dense mist rising up...
By the reflections of the brightnesses of all objects.
On the penalty of some who are immersed as it were in deep mists.
This is the sphere which is... like a mist...
A Spirit who ascended like an invisible mist.
There came a great crowd... like a mist.
The falsities at first appeared like a gross mist; afterwards, like waters.
For there is a misty rock which goes over them...
The lower things appear as it were misty.
